title: Sebastian and the Wolf
premise: Ines Okafor, a cartographer who maps realms that shouldn't exist, has spent years keeping her guild's ledgers and her own head down. When a dying stranger named Sebastian—a man cursed to live as a wolf between moonrises—presses a bloodstained map into her hands, she learns she is the last heir of the covenant that once bound the unmapped realms together, a covenant her guild secretly broke. Hunted by the guild's enforcers and shadowed by Sebastian's wolf, Ines must reforge the covenant at the Wellspring of Names before the realms drift apart forever. She succeeds only by sacrificing the ledger of her own memories, choosing truth over the comfortable lies of loyalty—and in the end, Sebastian, freed of his curse but stripped of their shared past, chooses to find her again from the beginning.
about_author: Petra Zhou is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing maps of places that no longer exist. She writes fantasy about people who keep records of impossible things.

chapters.title: The Ledger of Impossible Things
chapters.summary: Ines Okafor catalogs a shipment of bottled starlight for the Guild of Unmapped Realms, establishing her careful, invisible life among its ledgers. Her POV establishes her gift: she can read the true shape of any map, even ones drawn in lies. Emotional beat: quiet contentment built on deliberate self-erasure.

chapters.title: A Stranger at the Salt Door
chapters.summary: On a fog-bound night, a wounded stranger collapses against the guild's salt-warded door, half-man and half-wolf, clutching a map sealed in wax. Ines hides him in the map vault against every rule she's ever obeyed. His POV flickers through fever dreams of a broken oath. Emotional beat: first crack in her invisibility.

chapters.title: What the Dying Press Into Your Hands
chapters.summary: Sebastian names Ines heir to the Covenant of Threads before the guild healers can silence him, pressing the map into her hands as it burns itself into her skin. The guildmaster arrives too late to stop the transfer. Ines's POV; terror and unwilling inheritance. Emotional beat: the moment staying invisible stops being an option.

chapters.title: The Guildmaster's Kindness
chapters.summary: Guildmaster Vey offers Ines protection—if she surrenders the map for 'safekeeping.' Her cartographer's sight shows her the guild's own charter is a forgery layered over the original covenant. Ines's POV. Emotional beat: loyalty to the guild begins curdling into suspicion.

chapters.title: Wolf at Moonrise
chapters.summary: Ines smuggles Sebastian out through the catacombs as the moon rises and he transforms; the wolf spares her when instinct says kill. Sebastian's POV inside the curse—fragments of memory, hunger, and one clear image: Ines's face from a life he doesn't remember living. Emotional beat: fear braided with recognition.

chapters.title: The Road That Isn't on Any Map
chapters.summary: Fleeing along a road only Ines can perceive, they reach the border town of Ashfall, where the sky visibly frays where two realms are drifting apart. Ines's POV; the stakes become visible and physical. Emotional beat: awe curdling into dread at what the broken covenant is costing.

chapters.title: Debts in Ashfall
chapters.summary: In Ashfall, a fence named Corvo recognizes Sebastian's wolf-shape and demands an old debt: the name of the person who betrayed the covenant twenty years ago. Sebastian's POV—he cannot remember, and the not-knowing humiliates him. Emotional beat: shame, and Ines choosing to stand beside him anyway.

chapters.title: Enforcers of the Forged Charter
chapters.summary: Guild enforcers led by the implacable Sister Hallow catch up to them; Ines uses a folded-space trick from her ledgers to escape, but Corvo is taken. Ines's POV, guilt over collateral damage. Emotional beat: the cost of running becomes personal.

chapters.title: The Cartographer's Inheritance
chapters.summary: Sheltering in her estranged mother's abandoned survey station, Ines finds her mother's field notes: her mother was the covenant's last sworn keeper, and died trying to repair it. Ines's POV. Emotional beat: grief reframed—invisibility was never safety, only a slower death.

chapters.title: Three Names Missing
chapters.summary: The map reveals the covenant requires three sworn keepers; two names are struck through, and the third space bears Ines's own name, written by her mother years ago. Sebastian's POV watching her absorb it. Emotional beat: destiny as something chosen long before she agreed to it.

chapters.title: Hollow Chapel, Honest Thief
chapters.summary: They recruit Maren, a disgraced priestess who once kept the second name, now selling fake relics in a hollow chapel. Maren refuses until the fraying sky cracks open above the town. Maren's POV chapter. Emotional beat: cowardice confronted with undeniable evidence.

chapters.title: Sister Hallow's Offer
chapters.summary: Hallow corners them alone and offers truth instead of capture: Vey broke the covenant deliberately to consolidate the guild's monopoly on passage between realms. Ines's POV, torn between Hallow's honesty and her methods. Emotional beat: loyalty vs. truth made explicit for the first time.

chapters.title: The Wolf Remembers Fire
chapters.summary: Crossing the Glasswood, a fire triggers Sebastian's buried memory: he was the covenant's first keeper, and Vey was once his friend. Sebastian's POV, the past arriving in fragments. Emotional beat: rage at Vey, and terror that remembering will end whatever he and Ines are becoming.

chapters.title: What Ines Refuses to Write Down
chapters.summary: Ines admits she's been mapping their journey in a private ledger—including a page about Sebastian she keeps rewriting because she can't make the words honest. Ines's POV, intimate and confessional. Emotional beat: love acknowledged as a liability she refuses to erase.

chapters.title: Betrayal at the Ford
chapters.summary: Maren, offered restoration of her vows, betrays their route to Hallow; the ford ambush scatters the group and the map is seized. Sebastian's POV, captured in wolf-form. Emotional beat: despair, and Ines refusing to abandon him despite having nothing left.

chapters.title: The Vault Beneath the Guild
chapters.summary: Ines walks back into the guild alone, using her ledger-knowledge to navigate its defenses, and discovers the original covenant document hidden beneath Vey's floor—along with records proving her mother's death was arranged. Ines's POV. Emotional beat: cold, clarifying anger.

chapters.title: Vey's Confession
chapters.summary: Confronted, Vey argues the covenant's fall was mercy: bound realms meant bound suffering, and the guild merely profited from the gap. Ines sees the genuine conviction beneath the corruption. Ines's POV. Emotional beat: the antagonist almost wins by being half-right.

chapters.title: The Wellspring of Names
chapters.summary: Ines frees Sebastian and Maren (who turned witness against Hallow), and they race to the Wellspring as the realms' separation accelerates—cities flickering out of alignment around them. Rotating close-third POV, breathless momentum. Emotional beat: unity forged from three broken keepers.

chapters.title: The Price of a True Name
chapters.summary: At the Wellspring, the covenant demands a keeper's memories as ink. Ines writes herself into the oath, surrendering every memory of Sebastian—their whole journey dissolving as she signs. Sebastian's POV, forced to watch and hold her steady. Emotional beat: sacrifice as the ultimate act of truth-telling.

chapters.title: Realms Made Whole
chapters.summary: The covenant reforges; the frayed borders knit closed, Vey is unmade by the very gap he profited from, and Hallow kneels to the restored law. Sebastian, curse lifted and human, stands beside an Ines who no longer knows him. Sebastian's POV. Emotional beat: triumph shadowed by loss.

chapters.title: A Stranger at the Salt Door, Again
chapters.summary: Weeks later, Ines rebuilds the guild's ledgers honestly, feeling an ache she can't source. A stranger knocks at the salt door with a map sealed in wax and asks her to teach him the roads. Sebastian's POV mirroring chapter two. Emotional beat: hope as a choice made without memory's help.

chapters.title: Sebastian and the Wolf
chapters.summary: Ines opens the ledger to a fresh page and writes both their names side by side—not as keepers, but as beginning. The wolf-shaped scar on her palm warms; somewhere, the covenant approves. Alternating final beats from both POVs. Emotional beat: inheritance transformed from burden into invitation.
